description: This Java interface 'Permissions' defines a set-like collection for managing permissions, extending Set<String> and Jsonifiable<JsonArray>. It includes factory methods for creating permission instances, supports JSON schema versioning, and provides methods for checking permission containment.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new immutable Permissions instance containing specified permissions.

methods.name: none
methods.description: Returns an immutable Permissions instance with no permissions.

methods.name: getSupportedSchemaVersions
methods.description: Returns the JSON schema versions supported by Permissions, specifically V_2.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if the set contains all specified permissions, either by single or multiple permission arguments.
